motionEvidenceAndLimits.reportedChecks: GLB attention clip; three 60-second seeded unattended runs at two time steps; directed visitor-rail responses; retreat before and after commitment; inspection interruptions.
motionEvidenceAndLimits.kinematics: Browser motion is scripted/kinematic: goal-driven root movement, alternating planted/swinging feet, a two-link leg solve, body and wing pose offsets, and bounded bill reach to a fixed rail zone. The validation report measures controller behavior and pose/contact conditions.
motionEvidenceAndLimits.notForcePhysics: No rigid-body force simulation, measured center of mass, validated balance, material strength, impact force, or engineered joint loads are established. Planted-foot and contact checks are controller constraints, not proof of physical force or collision fidelity.
motionEvidenceAndLimits.acceptance: The review captures are local technical evidence only. Likeness, motion quality, physical credibility, owner acceptance, and publication approval remain pending.

validationSummary.runtimeChangeIncluded: The model is explicitly referenced by the app; this ledger itself is not in the runtime allowlist or public directory.

limits: This ledger records a local prototype and file/contract checks; it is not an artistic sign-off or finished production model declaration.
